title: Subsurface conditions.
officialText: The special inspections for existing subsurface conditions, fill placement and load-bearing requirements shall be performed in accordance with Sections 1704.7.1 through 1704.7.3. The approved geotechnical report, required by Section 1802.2, shall be used to determine compliance.
